description: Take one of the user's published stealth (anonymised) CVs offline; its public page then returns not found. Signed-in; not PRO. Pass the stealthId from create_takemeup_stealth_cv, or the token at the end of the public stealth link.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

stealthId.description: The stealthId returned when it was published, or the token from its public link (…/stealth/<token>).

name: revoke_takemeup_stealth_cv
title: Revoke a stealth CV
